bio: Adrian has more than five years of international debate experience. name: Sandeep Chulani
achievements: Ranked Top 10 judge in Asia at multiple Asian British Parliamentary Championships
Former Coach and Selector, Team HK
Former Chair, Hong Kong Schools Debating and Public Speaking Community
Co-founder, Hong Kong British Parliamentary Debating Championships (HKBPDC)
bio: Sandeep Chulani, a Hong Kong-based debate coach and educator, was formerly Coach and Selector of Team HK. He has over 20 years of debating, coaching, and judging experience and has been ranked among the Top 10 judges in Asia at multiple Asian British Parliamentary Championships. He co-founded HKBPDC, formerly chaired Hong Kong Schools Debating and Public Speaking Community, captained The University of Hong Kong English Debate Team, and served as Chief Adjudicator of HKBPDC 2014. He has led students onto the Hong Kong national squad and to WSDC, WIDPSC, and Oxford Schools.

bio: Matthew led Winchester College's Debate Society. He has four years of BP debating and adjudication experience and more than two years of coaching experience. He competed at ICYD and Cambridge Schools. His coaching covers politics, economics, and international relations motions.
